chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Amr ibn Abi al-Miqdam, from Muhammad ibn Marwan, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

Regarding the bequest of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) to the Commander of the Faithful (may Allah's prayers be upon him): 'Upon you is the Siwak (brushing the teeth) for every prayer.'

key_terms.السِّوَاك: Using a toothbrush or twig for oral hygiene

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on using Siwak before prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration, transmitted through the chain of Imam al-Sadiq, highlights the Prophet’s specific bequest to Imam Ali, underscoring the spiritual and physical purity required for prayer in Shia tradition. It elevates the use of the Siwak from mere hygiene to a Sunnah act that prepares the believer for communion with God, reflecting the holistic nature of worship in the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings.
